payload.description:
As a household member watching a turn, I want ordered progress while the bot works, so that the product feels alive without a persistent connection.

Feature: Turn-scoped progress stream

Scenario: Watch an active turn
  Given a bot is producing an answer for a turn
  And the member is watching that turn
  When the bot produces several coalesced progress chunks
  Then the member receives the chunks in order before completion
  And the member receives one terminal event
  And the stream ends with the turn
  And no connection remains open for the channel or chat tab
payload.title: Watch one active turn through server-sent events
